verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a few fixed, domain-specific automations that a merchant configures once and that then run in the background: automatic invoice payment reminders, recurring subscription billing, and automated recovery of failed payments. It offers no general-purpose way to define, schedule, or trigger autonomous automations or agents. The agent toolkit, MCP server and webhooks are developer building blocks for constructing such automations, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation/workflow builder, scheduled or triggered autonomous agent runs hosted by PayPal, background-run monitoring and controls, and independent corroboration.
